# KhmerSoftware (ខ្មែរសូហ្វវែរ)

> Cambodia's Premier Enterprise Software Development & IT Solutions Company

KhmerSoftware is a leading software engineering agency based in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. We specialize in custom software development, mobile application engineering, cloud infrastructure & AWS migration, cybersecurity audits, DevOps automation, and digital transformation consulting.

## Core Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/custom): Bespoke enterprise systems, internal tools, ERP integrations, and workflow automation.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/mobile): Native and cross-platform apps with offline-first support and local payment integration.
- [Web Application Engineering](https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/web): High-performance, scalable SaaS platforms and customer portals.
- [Cloud Infrastructure & AWS Migration](https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/cloud): Zero-downtime cloud migration, architecture reviews, and cost optimization.
- [DevOps & CI/CD Services](https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/devops): Automated deployment pipelines, containerization, and Kubernetes orchestration.
- [Cybersecurity & Penetration Testing](https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/security): Vulnerability assessments, code security audits, and compliance readiness.
- [IT Strategy & Consulting](https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/strategy): Technology roadmaps, system architecture advisory, and digital transformation.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/design): User research, Figma design systems, and interactive bilingual prototypes.
